deals.headline_en: GSK announces $10.6B acquisition of Nuvalent, securing next-gen ALK/ROS1 inhibitors for NSCLC
deals.asset_zh: neladalkib（NVL-655，新一代高选择性ALK抑制剂）、zidesamtinib（NVL-520，新一代高选择性ROS1抑制剂），均已提交FDA审评
deals.asset_en: neladalkib (NVL-655, next-gen ALK inhibitor) and zidesamtinib (NVL-520, next-gen ROS1 inhibitor), both under FDA review
deals.modality_zh: 小分子靶向药（下一代激酶抑制剂）
deals.modality_en: Small molecule targeted therapy (next-gen kinase inhibitors)
deals.summary_zh: 2026年6月9日，GSK宣布以每股124美元现金（股权总价106亿美元，扣除现金后净投入约94亿美元）收购Nuvalent，预计2026年第三季度完成。Nuvalent开发的neladalkib（ALK抑制剂）和zidesamtinib（ROS1抑制剂）均为下一代高度选择性激酶抑制剂，正在接受FDA审评，有望克服现有ALK/ROS1抑制剂的耐药问题，此次交易为GSK史上最大规模并购之一。
deals.summary_en: On June 9, 2026, GSK announced definitive agreement to acquire Nuvalent for $124 per share in cash, total equity value $10.6B (net of cash ~$9.4B). Transaction expected to close Q3 2026. Nuvalent's neladalkib (ALK inhibitor) and zidesamtinib (ROS1 inhibitor) are next-gen, highly selective kinase inhibitors under FDA review, designed to overcome resistance to current ALK/ROS1 inhibitors in NSCLC. This is among GSK's largest acquisitions ever, marking a significant oncology push.

BMS pays $600M upfront plus $175M at first anniversary (2027) and up to $175M at second anniversary (2028). Hengrui leads early clinical development through proof-of-concept.

deals.summary_zh: 2026年3月，德琪医药与UCB达成全球独家授权协议，将ATG-201（靶向CD19/CD3的B细胞耗竭型双特异性T细胞衔接器）的全球权利（大中华区以外）授权给UCB。UCB支付6000万美元首付及2000万美元近期里程碑，共8000万美元近期付款，加上最高超10亿美元里程碑及分级特许权使用费，潜在总额逾11亿美元。德琪保留在中国及澳大利亚的I期临床主导权并于完成后移交UCB。
deals.summary_en: In March 2026, Antengene and UCB entered a global exclusive license agreement for ATG-201, a masked CD19/CD3 bispecific T-cell engager for B cell-related autoimmune diseases, granting UCB worldwide rights excluding Greater China. UCB pays $60M upfront and $20M near-term milestone ($80M total near-term), plus over $1.1B in success-based milestones and tiered royalties. Antengene leads Phase 1 studies in China and Australia before handing development to UCB.

deals.summary_en: On February 23, 2026, Gilead announced definitive agreement to acquire Arcellx for $115 per share in cash plus one $5 CVR per share (payable if global anito-cel sales reach $6B by end of 2029), implying ~$7.8B total equity value. Anito-cel BLA has been accepted by FDA with a PDUFA date of December 23, 2026.

deals.asset_en: All Gracell shares; lead asset GC012F (BCMA/CD19 dual-targeting FasTCAR-T for MM and SLE)
deals.modality_zh: 自体CAR-T细胞疗法（FasTCAR次日制备平台）
deals.modality_en: Autologous CAR-T cell therapy (FasTCAR next-day manufacturing platform)
deals.summary_zh: 2023年12月26日，阿斯利康宣布以全现金方式收购在美上市的亘喜生物，每普通股2美元（每ADS 10美元，约10亿美元）加最高0.3美元/股（1.5美元/ADS）的条件价值权，合计最高约12亿美元，较亘喜股价溢价62%-86%。收购于2024年2月22日完成。亘喜核心资产为FasTCAR技术平台（次日制备CAR-T），以及GC012F（BCMA/CD19双靶点，正推进多发性骨髓瘤和系统性红斑狼疮适应症）。阿斯利康通过此次收购进入细胞治疗领域并拓展自身免疫疾病管线。
deals.summary_en: On December 26, 2023, AstraZeneca announced the all-cash acquisition of Nasdaq-listed Gracell Biotechnologies at $2.00 per ordinary share ($10.00/ADS, ~$1.0 billion upfront) plus a contingent value right of up to $0.30/share ($1.50/ADS) upon a regulatory milestone, for a total potential value of ~$1.2 billion (86% premium to Gracell's closing price). The transaction closed on February 22, 2024. Key asset GC012F is a FasTCAR-T dual-targeting BCMA and CD19 in development for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma and autoimmune diseases including SLE. The deal marks AstraZeneca's entry into cell therapy and its expansion into autoimmune indications.

deals.asset_zh: PM8002（BNT327，PD-L1/VEGF-A双特异性抗体）
deals.asset_en: PM8002 / BNT327 — PD-L1/VEGF-A bispecific antibody
deals.summary_zh: 2023年11月，普米斯生物与BioNTech签署独家全球授权及合作协议，就PD-L1/VEGF-A双特异性抗体PM8002（后命名BNT327）授予BioNTech大中华区以外的全球开发、生产和商业化权利。首付款5500万美元，潜在里程碑超过10亿美元，另有分层特许权使用费。普米斯保留大中华区权利。BioNTech于2024年11月收购普米斯，取得全球全部权益。
deals.summary_en: In November 2023, Biotheus entered into an exclusive global license and collaboration agreement with BioNTech for PM8002 (BNT327), a bispecific antibody combining PD-L1 checkpoint inhibition with VEGF-A neutralization. BioNTech received exclusive rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize BNT327 globally ex-Greater China. Biotheus received $55M upfront and was eligible for over $1B in development, regulatory and commercial milestones plus tiered royalties. Biotheus retained Greater China rights. This license was superseded by BioNTech's full acquisition of Biotheus in November 2024.

deals.summary_en: Amgen announced in December 2022 and completed on October 6, 2023 the all-cash acquisition of Horizon Therapeutics at $116.50 per share (~$27.8 billion), Amgen's largest-ever deal. After FTC antitrust challenge and a consent decree prohibiting bundling, the deal closed, significantly strengthening Amgen's rare disease commercial portfolio.

deals.headline_en: Merck and Daiichi Sankyo Announce Up-to-$22B Global Collaboration for Three DXd ADC Candidates
deals.asset_zh: patritumab deruxtecan（HER3-DXd）、ifinatamab deruxtecan（I-DXd）、raludotatug deruxtecan（R-DXd）
deals.asset_en: Patritumab deruxtecan (HER3-DXd), Ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), Raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd)
deals.modality_zh: DXd抗体偶联药物（ADC）平台，靶点分别为HER3、B7-H3、CDH6
deals.modality_en: DXd ADC platform targeting HER3, B7-H3 and CDH6 respectively
deals.therapeutic_area: Oncology (NSCLC, small cell lung cancer, renal/ovarian cancers, multiple solid tumors)
deals.summary_zh: 2023年10月19日，默沙东与第一三共签署全球合作协议，共同开发和商业化三款DXd ADC候选药物：patritumab deruxtecan（HER3-DXd）、ifinatamab deruxtecan（I-DXd）和raludotatug deruxtecan（R-DXd）。默沙东支付40亿美元首付款，另加未来24个月内15亿美元分期付款，加上最高165亿美元销售里程碑，交易潜在总额高达220亿美元。这是制药行业迄今最大规模的ADC合作交易之一，双方在日本以外地区平等分担成本和利润。
deals.summary_en: On October 19, 2023, Merck and Daiichi Sankyo entered a global collaboration for three DXd ADC candidates: patritumab deruxtecan (HER3-DXd), ifinatamab deruxtecan (I-DXd), and raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd). Merck paid $4B upfront plus $1.5B in continuation payments over 24 months, with up to $16.5B in sales milestone payments, totaling a potential $22B. The parties equally share costs and profits worldwide (ex-Japan). This is among the largest ADC collaborations in pharma history.

Combined $270M upfront, ~$3.21B total potential, GSK gets ex-Greater China global rights.

deals.summary_zh: 2023年10月8日，智飞生物与葛兰素史克生物、葛兰素史克香港签署《独家经销和联合推广协议》，取得重组带状疱疹疫苗（Shingrix/欣安立适）在中国大陆的独家进口、推广和销售权。协议期为2023年10月至2026年12月，三年最低采购金额：2024年34.4亿元、2025年68.8亿元、2026年103.2亿元，合计206.4亿元（约合28.4亿美元）。协议同时约定探索RSV老年疫苗中国合作。Shingrix于2019年5月在中国获批，2020年6月正式上市，此前由上海医药代理。2024年12月，双方进一步将合作延长至2034年，2024-2029年预测采购额约216亿元。
deals.summary_en: On October 8, 2023, Zhifei Biologics signed an Exclusive Distribution and Joint Promotion Agreement with GSK Biologicals and GSK Hong Kong for the exclusive import, promotion and distribution of the recombinant zoster vaccine Shingrix (Xinganlixi) in mainland China. The agreement runs from October 2023 to December 2026, with minimum annual purchase commitments of CNY 3.44B (2024), 6.88B (2025), and 10.32B (2026) — totaling CNY 20.64B (~$2.84B). The deal also includes an exclusive option to co-develop and commercialize GSK's RSV elderly vaccine in China. In December 2024, the partnership was extended to 2034 with ~CNY 21.6B in projected purchases for 2024-2029.

deals.modality_zh: 自体CAR-T细胞疗法联合mRNA癌症疫苗

deals.summary_zh: 2023年8月21日，科济药业与莫德纳宣布达成研究合作，将在临床前及I期研究中评估科济CT041（靶向Claudin18.2的CAR-T，适用于胃癌、胰腺癌等消化道实体瘤）与莫德纳在研Claudin18.2 mRNA癌症疫苗的联合治疗潜力。CT041是全球首个进入实体瘤确证性II期临床的CAR-T产品，已获FDA RMAT认定及EMA PRIME资格。双方未披露具体财务条款，成本由双方共担。
deals.summary_en: On August 21, 2023, CARsgen Therapeutics and Moderna announced a research collaboration to evaluate CARsgen's CT041 (satri-cel, targeting Claudin18.2 in gastric/pancreatic cancer) in combination with Moderna's investigational Claudin18.2 mRNA cancer vaccine in preclinical and Phase I studies. CT041 holds FDA RMAT Designation and EMA PRIME eligibility; it is the world's first CAR-T candidate to enter a confirmatory Phase II trial for solid tumors. No financial terms were disclosed; costs are co-shared.

deals.summary_en: On January 16, 2023, CARsgen Therapeutics (HKEX: 02171) and Huadong Medicine announced an exclusive commercialization collaboration for zevor-cel (CT053) in mainland China. Huadong pays RMB 200 million (~USD 29.7M) upfront plus up to RMB 1,025 million (~USD 152M) in regulatory and commercial milestones, for a total potential value of ~USD 182 million. CARsgen retains responsibility for development, regulatory submission, and manufacturing. Zevor-cel received NMPA approval on February 23, 2024 for R/R multiple myeloma.

deals.headline_en: Merck Pays $250M to Exercise Option for Joint Development of Moderna's Personalized mRNA Cancer Vaccine mRNA-4157/V940
deals.asset_zh: mRNA-4157/V940 个性化新抗原mRNA癌症疫苗（联合Keytruda）
deals.asset_en: mRNA-4157/V940 Personalized Neoantigen mRNA Cancer Vaccine (in combination with Keytruda/pembrolizumab)
deals.summary_zh: 该合作始于2016年原始协议（默沙东首付2亿美元获得期权），2018年修订。2022年10月12日，默沙东支付2.5亿美元正式行权，与莫德纳进入50/50联合开发及商业化。核心资产mRNA-4157/V940是针对个体患者肿瘤突变的个性化新抗原疫苗，联合K药（pembrolizumab）用于高危黑色素瘤术后辅助治疗。Phase 2b KEYNOTE-942研究达到主要疗效终点（降低复发/死亡风险44%），已获FDA突破性疗法认定；双方成本与利润全球均等分担。
deals.summary_en: The original Collaboration and License Agreement was signed in 2016 (Merck paid $200M upfront for option rights) and amended in 2018. On October 12, 2022, Merck exercised its option with a $250M payment to enter a worldwide 50/50 co-development and co-commercialization arrangement with Moderna for mRNA-4157/V940 — a personalized neoantigen mRNA vaccine targeting mutations unique to each patient's tumor, evaluated with Keytruda (pembrolizumab) in adjuvant melanoma. The Phase 2b KEYNOTE-942 trial met its primary efficacy endpoint (44% reduction in recurrence/death risk), and the program received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation.

deals.asset_zh: VLS-101（zilovertamab vedotin）—靶向ROR1的抗体偶联药物，用于血液肿瘤和实体瘤
deals.asset_en: VLS-101 (zilovertamab vedotin) - ROR1-targeted antibody-drug conjugate for hematologic and solid tumors
deals.summary_zh: 2020年11月5日宣布，以27.5亿美元全现金收购VelosBio。核心资产VLS-101（zilovertamab vedotin）是靶向ROR1受体的ADC，I期临床显示在套细胞淋巴瘤和弥漫大B细胞淋巴瘤中客观缓解率分别高达47%和80%，进一步丰富了默沙东在K药之外的肿瘤学产品线。
deals.summary_en: Announced November 5, 2020. All-cash acquisition for $2.75B. Lead asset VLS-101 (zilovertamab vedotin) targets ROR1; Phase 1 showed 47% ORR in MCL and 80% ORR in DLBCL. Broadens Merck's oncology franchise beyond Keytruda.

deals.asset_zh: Trodelvy（sacituzumab govitecan）—首个靶向TROP-2的抗体偶联药物（ADC）
deals.asset_en: Trodelvy (sacituzumab govitecan) - first-in-class TROP-2 directed ADC
deals.summary_zh: 2020年9月13日宣布，10月23日完成交割，以每股88美元全现金方式收购Immunomedics，总价约210亿美元，溢价108%。核心资产Trodelvy已于2020年4月获FDA加速批准用于三阴性乳腺癌，是首个靶向TROP-2的ADC，助力吉利德由抗病毒领域向肿瘤学战略转型。
deals.summary_en: Announced September 13, 2020; closed October 23, 2020. All-cash deal at $88/share (~$21B, 108% premium). Core asset Trodelvy received FDA accelerated approval for TNBC in April 2020. The acquisition accelerated Gilead's strategic pivot from antivirals to oncology.

deals.headline_en: CStone out-licenses sugemalimab and CS1003 ex-Greater China rights to EQRx
deals.asset_zh: 苏格利单抗（Sugemalimab，CS1001，抗PD-L1）及CS1003（抗PD-1）两个免疫检查点抑制剂
deals.asset_en: Sugemalimab (CS1001, anti-PD-L1) and CS1003 (anti-PD-1), two immune checkpoint inhibitors
deals.summary_zh: 2020年10月26日，基石药业与EQRx签署全球战略合作协议，将苏格利单抗（抗PD-L1）和CS1003（抗PD-1）在除中国大陆、台湾、香港、澳门以外全球市场的开发与商业化权利授权EQRx；基石获首付款1.5亿美元，可获最高11.5亿美元里程碑，另获两款药物的梯度版权费。
deals.summary_en: On October 26, 2020, CStone Pharmaceuticals and EQRx entered a global strategic partnership. CStone out-licensed exclusive ex-Greater China rights to sugemalimab (anti-PD-L1, CS1001) and CS1003 (anti-PD-1) to EQRx for EQRx to lead global development and commercialization. CStone received $150M upfront and is eligible for up to $1.15B in milestone payments for both programs, plus separate tiered royalties.

deals.headline_en: Innovent out-licenses sintilimab ex-China rights to Eli Lilly (terminated 2022)
deals.asset_zh: 信迪利单抗（Sintilimab，TYVYT®），抗PD-1单抗
deals.asset_en: Sintilimab (Tyvyt/IBI301), anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody
deals.summary_zh: 2020年8月，信达生物与礼来宣布扩大战略联盟，信达将信迪利单抗中国境外全球权利授权礼来；礼来支付首付款2亿美元，潜在里程碑最高8.25亿美元（总价值约10.3亿美元），并支付双位数梯度版权费。2022年3月，FDA向礼来发出完整回复函，拒绝批准信迪利单抗用于NSCLC一线治疗（因试验数据缺乏全球适用性）；2022年10月，礼来正式终止合作并将权利归还信达。
deals.summary_en: In August 2020, Innovent Biologics and Eli Lilly expanded their strategic alliance, with Innovent granting Lilly an exclusive ex-China license for sintilimab (Tyvyt). Lilly paid $200M upfront and was eligible for up to $825M in milestones (total ~$1.03B), plus tiered double-digit royalties. In March 2022, the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter rejecting sintilimab in NSCLC (citing trial data limited to Chinese patients). Lilly terminated the agreement in October 2022 and returned all ex-China rights to Innovent.

deals.headline_en: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo Announce Global Collaboration for Datopotamab Deruxtecan (Dato-DXd, DS-1062)
deals.asset_zh: datopotamab deruxtecan（Dato-DXd，DS-1062）
deals.asset_en: Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd, DS-1062)
deals.therapeutic_area: Oncology (NSCLC, breast cancer, other TROP2-expressing solid tumors)
deals.summary_zh: 2020年7月，阿斯利康与第一三共就TROP2靶向ADC药物DS-1062（datopotamab deruxtecan，后命名为Dato-DXd）签署全球开发与商业化合作协议。阿斯利康支付10亿美元首付款，并承担最高10亿美元监管里程碑和最高40亿美元销售里程碑，总交易潜在价值达60亿美元。这是双方继Enhertu之后的第二笔重磅ADC合作，日本以外市场共同开发和商业化。
deals.summary_en: In July 2020, AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo entered a global collaboration for TROP2-directed ADC DS-1062 (datopotamab deruxtecan/Dato-DXd). AstraZeneca paid $1B upfront, plus up to $1B in regulatory milestones and up to $4B in sales milestones, totaling up to $6B. This was the second major ADC collaboration between the two companies, following their Enhertu deal.

deals.summary_zh: 2020年6月，金斯瑞生物科技旗下细胞治疗子公司传奇生物（2014年创立，2020年分拆）在纳斯达克完成IPO，以每ADS 23美元（高于原定18-20美元区间）发行1,840万ADS，融资约4.24亿美元；含超额配股及金斯瑞2,300万美元私募配售后总融资约4.87亿美元。分拆后金斯瑞仍持有传奇约76.9%股权。传奇的核心管线LCAR-B38M/cilta-cel当时正与强生杨森推进全球开发。
deals.summary_en: In June 2020, Legend Biotech (founded November 2014 as a GenScript subsidiary) completed its Nasdaq IPO at $23 per ADS — above the $18-20 range — raising approximately $424 million from 18.4 million ADSs, with total proceeds of ~$487 million including the over-allotment and a $23 million concurrent private placement to GenScript. Post-IPO, GenScript retained ~76.9% of Legend. The core pipeline asset at the time was LCAR-B38M / cilta-cel, under global development with Janssen.

deals.summary_en: Announced June 25, 2019; closed May 8, 2020. AbbVie acquired Allergan for $120.30 cash plus 0.866 AbbVie shares per share, totaling ~$63B. The deal significantly diversified AbbVie's revenue base via Botox therapeutics and global aesthetics, hedging against Humira's upcoming patent cliff.

deals.asset_zh: zimberelimab（抗PD-1）、domvanalimab（抗TIGIT）及Arcus全部在研管线期权
deals.asset_en: Zimberelimab (anti-PD-1), domvanalimab (anti-TIGIT) and option rights over all Arcus pipeline programs
deals.modality_zh: 肿瘤免疫检查点抑制剂及腺苷通路抑制剂
deals.modality_en: Immuno-oncology checkpoint inhibitors and adenosine pathway inhibitors
deals.summary_zh: 2020年5月，吉利德与Arcus Biosciences签署为期十年的肿瘤免疫合作协议，同年7月交割完成。吉利德支付1.75亿美元首付款并直接获得zimberelimab（抗PD-1）的共同开发商业化权利，同时另行投入2亿美元股权（6%股权）。协议期内吉利德可按每个项目2亿至2.75亿美元的费用行权选择Arcus所有其他临床项目。2021年11月，吉利德行权三个项目（domvanalimab、etrumadenant、quemliclustat）支付7.25亿美元。
deals.summary_en: In May 2020 (closing July 2020), Gilead entered a 10-year collaboration with Arcus Biosciences, paying $175M upfront for immediate zimberelimab co-development rights plus $200M equity investment. Gilead received an option to license each Arcus clinical program for $200M–$275M per program. In November 2021, Gilead exercised options on three programs (domvanalimab, etrumadenant, quemliclustat) for $725M. The deal also included R&D support of up to $400M over the collaboration term.

deals.asset_en: Magrolimab (5F9) - anti-CD47 'do not eat me' monoclonal antibody for MDS, AML, DLBCL

deals.summary_en: Announced March 2, 2020. All-cash acquisition at $95.50/share (~$4.9B, ~66% premium). Core asset magrolimab blocks CD47 'do not eat me' signal to restore macrophage-mediated tumor clearance; in multiple trials for MDS, AML, and DLBCL. Part of Gilead's broader oncology build-out.

deals.asset_zh: BNT162b2 mRNA新冠疫苗（Comirnaty）
deals.asset_en: BNT162b2 mRNA COVID-19 Vaccine (Comirnaty)
deals.summary_zh: 2020年3月17日，辉瑞与拜恩泰科签署合作意向书，共同开发和商业化mRNA新冠疫苗（中国大陆除外）。辉瑞向拜恩泰科支付1.85亿美元首付款（含7200万美元现金及1.13亿美元股权投资），并有权获得最高5.63亿美元里程碑款，潜在总额7.48亿美元。双方各承担50%研发成本，利润50/50分成。该疫苗即后来获批的Comirnaty，2022年峰值销售额达378亿美元。
deals.summary_en: On March 17, 2020, Pfizer and BioNTech signed a letter of intent and Material Transfer & Collaboration Agreement to co-develop and distribute (ex-China) an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine. Pfizer paid BioNTech $185M upfront ($72M cash + $113M equity investment) with up to $563M in milestones (total potential $748M). Development costs and gross profits are shared 50/50. The vaccine launched as Comirnaty, generating peak annual revenues of ~$37.8B in 2022.

deals.summary_en: On March 16, 2020, Fosun Pharma and BioNTech announced a strategic development and commercialization collaboration for BNT162 vaccines in Greater China (mainland, HK, Macau, Taiwan). Fosun Pharma invested ~$50M (EUR 44M) for 1,580,777 BioNTech ordinary shares, gaining exclusive clinical development, regulatory, and commercial rights in Greater China. BioNTech supplies vaccine from GMP facilities in Europe. In December 2020, a supply agreement for an initial 100 million doses to mainland China was announced. The vaccine received EUA in HK/Taiwan but was never approved in mainland China.

deals.summary_zh: 作为BMS收购新基的FTC监管前提，新基（由BMS代为）将Otezla全球权益以134亿美元全现金出售给安进。2019年11月21日完成交割，是迄今单一药品资产出售规模最大的交易之一。Otezla是唯一口服、非生物制剂的银屑病及银屑病关节炎治疗选择，纳入安进的炎症业务线。
deals.summary_en: As a mandatory FTC divestiture condition for BMS's acquisition of Celgene, Celgene sold global Otezla rights to Amgen for $13.4B all-cash. Closed November 21, 2019. One of the largest single-asset divestitures on record. Otezla is the only oral non-biologic option for psoriasis/PsA, folded into Amgen's inflammation franchise.

deals.headline_en: Innovent Biologics In-Licenses Mazdutide (OXM3) from Eli Lilly for China
deals.asset_zh: 玛仕度肽（mazdutide/IBI362，OXM3，GLP-1R/GCGR双重激动剂）
deals.asset_en: Mazdutide (IBI362/OXM3, GLP-1R/GCGR dual agonist)
deals.summary_zh: 2019年8月，信达生物宣布与礼来制药达成授权协议，获得OXM3（即玛仕度肽/IBI362）在大中华区的独家开发及商业化权利；礼来保留中国以外地区权利。OXM3为GLP-1受体与胰高糖素受体双重激动剂，具有同类最优潜力。具体财务条款未披露。玛仕度肽已于2025年6月在中国获批减重适应症（商品名信尔美），是全球首个获批的GCG/GLP-1双受体激动剂减重药。
deals.summary_en: In August 2019, Innovent Biologics announced a licensing agreement with Eli Lilly to develop and commercialize OXM3 (mazdutide/IBI362), a dual GLP-1R/GCGR agonist, in China. Financial terms were not disclosed. Mazdutide received NMPA approval for chronic weight management in June 2025 (brand name Xin'erme), becoming the world's first approved GCG/GLP-1 dual receptor agonist weight-loss drug.

deals.headline_zh: 阿斯利康与第一三共就曲妥珠单抗德鲁替康（Enhertu）签署全球开发及商业化合作协议
deals.headline_en: AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo Sign Global Collaboration for Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (Enhertu/DS-8201)
deals.asset_zh: 曲妥珠单抗德鲁替康（Enhertu，DS-8201）
deals.asset_en: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (Enhertu, DS-8201)
deals.therapeutic_area: Oncology (HER2+ breast cancer, gastric cancer, other solid tumors)
deals.summary_zh: 2019年3月，阿斯利康与第一三共就HER2靶向ADC药物DS-8201（后获批为Enhertu）签署全球开发与商业化合作协议。阿斯利康支付13.5亿美元首付款（分两期），并承担最高55亿美元的里程碑付款（监管里程碑38亿 + 销售里程碑17.5亿），交易总额最高达69亿美元。双方在日本以外市场平等分担研发成本及利润，第一三共负责全球生产供应。该合作使Enhertu成为全球ADC领域标志性合作案例。
deals.summary_en: In March 2019, AstraZeneca and Daiichi Sankyo entered a global development and commercialization collaboration for DS-8201 (later approved as Enhertu), a HER2-directed ADC. AstraZeneca paid $1.35B upfront (in two installments) plus up to $5.55B in contingent milestones ($3.8B regulatory, $1.75B sales), for a total potential deal value of $6.9B. The parties equally share development costs and profits worldwide (ex-Japan), with Daiichi Sankyo retaining sole manufacturing responsibility.

deals.headline_zh: 拜恩泰科与辉瑞签署流感mRNA疫苗多年研发合作，首付约1.2亿美元
deals.headline_en: BioNTech and Pfizer Sign Multi-Year mRNA Influenza Vaccine Collaboration — ~$120M Upfront
deals.asset_zh: mRNA流感疫苗候选物（后扩展至COVID-19+流感联合疫苗）
deals.asset_en: mRNA-based Influenza Vaccine Candidate (later expanded to COVID-19 + Influenza Combination Vaccine)
deals.summary_zh: 2018年8月16日，拜恩泰科与辉瑞签署多年期研发合作协议，共同开发mRNA流感疫苗。拜恩泰科获得约1.2亿美元首付款（含现金、股权及近期研究付款），另有最高3.05亿美元的开发、注册及商业里程碑款，潜在总额约4.25亿美元。拜恩泰科完成首次人体临床研究后，辉瑞承担全部后续临床开发及商业化责任。这是辉瑞与拜恩泰科在传染病领域的首个合作，为后续COVID-19及带状疱疹疫苗合作奠定框架，并于2022年进一步扩展至COVID-19与流感联合mRNA疫苗开发。
deals.summary_en: On August 16, 2018, BioNTech and Pfizer signed a multi-year research and development collaboration to develop mRNA-based influenza vaccines. BioNTech received ~$120M in upfront, equity and near-term research payments, plus up to $305M in development, regulatory and commercial milestone payments (total potential ~$425M). After BioNTech completes first-in-human trials, Pfizer assumes sole responsibility for further clinical development and commercialization. This was the first BioNTech-Pfizer infectious disease collaboration and provided the structural and organizational template for the subsequent COVID-19 vaccine partnership (2020) and shingles vaccine collaboration (2022), with the program later extended to a COVID-19 + influenza combination mRNA vaccine in 2022.

deals.headline_en: Legend Biotech and Janssen Enter Worldwide Collaboration and License Agreement for BCMA CAR-T Cilta-cel
deals.asset_zh: cilta-cel（西他奥仑赛，JNJ-4528/LCAR-B38M），BCMA靶向CAR-T
deals.asset_en: ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel / JNJ-4528 / LCAR-B38M), BCMA-directed CAR-T
deals.summary_zh: 2017年12月21日，传奇生物与强生旗下杨森生物技术签署全球独家合作授权协议，共同开发、生产和商业化BCMA靶向CAR-T产品LCAR-B38M（后更名cilta-cel/Carvykti）。杨森支付3.5亿美元首付款，并承诺在开发、监管及销售里程碑达成时支付额外款项；在大中华区以外市场实行50/50成本/利润分成，大中华区为传奇70%/杨森30%。Carvykti于2022年2月获FDA批准，2022年5月获欧盟批准，2024年4月FDA批准二线适应症扩展。传奇累计已收到里程碑款项逾3亿美元（截至2022年）。
deals.summary_en: On December 21, 2017, Legend Biotech (then a GenScript subsidiary) and Janssen Biotech entered an exclusive worldwide collaboration and license agreement to develop, manufacture, and commercialize LCAR-B38M (cilta-cel). Janssen paid a $350 million upfront, with additional milestone payments tied to development, regulatory, and sales achievements. Cost/profit split is 50/50 globally except Greater China (70% Legend / 30% Janssen). Carvykti was FDA-approved in February 2022 and received expanded second-line approval in April 2024. Cumulative milestones received by Legend exceeded $300 million as of 2022.

deals.asset_zh: Lynparza（奥拉帕利，PARP抑制剂）及司美替尼（selumetinib，MEK抑制剂）
deals.asset_en: Lynparza (olaparib, PARP inhibitor) and selumetinib (MEK inhibitor)

deals.therapeutic_area: Oncology (BRCA-mutated breast, ovarian, prostate, pancreatic cancers)
deals.summary_zh: 2017年7月27日，默沙东与阿斯利康签署全球战略肿瘤合作协议，共同开发和商业化PARP抑制剂Lynparza（奥拉帕利）及MEK抑制剂司美替尼。默沙东支付16亿美元首付款及7.5亿美元许可选择权费用，另外最高61.5亿美元里程碑付款，潜在总额85亿美元。双方平等分担两药的开发和商业化成本及总利润，各自独立资助本家PD-1/PD-L1产品与上述药物联合的研发项目。

Merck paid $1.6B upfront plus $750M in license option payments, and up to $6.15B in milestone payments, for a total potential deal value of $8.5B. The parties equally share development and commercialization costs and gross profits, while independently funding their own PD-1/PD-L1 combination programs.

deals.headline_en: Hengrui out-licenses camrelizumab (SHR-1210) ex-China rights to Incyte (terminated 2018)

The parties mutually agreed to terminate the agreement in February 2018, with Incyte returning all rights to Hengrui.

deals.headline_en: AstraZeneca and Moderna Sign Exclusive mRNA Therapeutics Collaboration — $240M Upfront, Up to 40 Products
deals.asset_zh: mRNA疗法平台（心脏代谢/肾病/肿瘤领域，最多40个靶点）
deals.asset_en: mRNA Therapeutics platform (cardiometabolic, renal, oncology — up to 40 drug products)
deals.summary_zh: 2013年3月21日，阿斯利康与莫德纳宣布独家合作协议，在心脏代谢、肾病及肿瘤领域探索和开发mRNA疗法。阿斯利康支付2.4亿美元首付款，另有最高1.8亿美元技术里程碑款（共4.2亿美元），并获得在五年期内选择多达40个mRNA药物靶点的独家权利；莫德纳另享有研发/商业里程碑及高个位数至低两位数比例的销售提成。这是早期mRNA平台技术的里程碑式合作，奠定了莫德纳进入传染病及肿瘤领域的资金基础。2016年后双方进一步在IO-肿瘤及心衰领域扩展合作。
deals.summary_en: On March 21, 2013, AstraZeneca and Moderna announced an exclusive collaboration agreement to discover, develop and commercialize mRNA therapeutics for serious cardiovascular, metabolic, renal, and oncology diseases. AstraZeneca paid $240M upfront plus up to $180M in technical milestones (potential total $420M), with an exclusive right to select up to 40 mRNA drug product candidates over five years. Moderna is entitled to high-single to low-double digit royalties on net sales plus development/commercial milestones. The deal was a landmark validation of early mRNA platform technology, providing foundational capital for Moderna's subsequent expansion into vaccines. Further collaborations (immuno-oncology in 2016; Relaxin/heart failure in 2017) built upon this initial agreement.

deals.therapeutic_area: Infectious Disease / HPV / Cervical Cancer Prevention
deals.summary_zh: 智飞生物与默沙东自2011年4月开展合作，2012年9月正式签署《供应、经销与共同推广协议》取得四价HPV疫苗独家经销权，2018年进一步获得九价HPV疫苗（Gardasil 9）独家代理资格。协议多次续签：2017年补充协议（2017-2021年累计基础采购约65亿元）；2018年修订（2019-2021年约180亿元）；2020年续签（2021-2023年上半年约281亿元）；2023年1月最新续约（协议期至2026年底，HPV相关基础采购额约980亿元，含其他疫苗超1000亿元）。协议为买断式采购无首付款，智飞承担全部库存风险。
deals.summary_en: Zhifei Biologics has been Merck's exclusive China mainland distributor for HPV vaccines since April 2011; a formal Supply, Distribution and Co-Promotion Agreement for 4-valent Gardasil was signed in September 2012. The 9-valent Gardasil 9 was added in 2018. The agreement has been renewed multiple times: 2017 supplement (CNY ~6.5B base purchase for 2017-2021); 2018 amendment (~CNY 18B for 2019-2021); 2020 renewal (~CNY 28B for 2021-H1 2023); January 2023 renewal (to Dec 2026, HPV-related base purchases ~CNY 98B; total incl. other vaccines >CNY 100B). The deal is structured as a committed minimum purchase arrangement with no traditional upfront fee; Zhifei bears full inventory risk.

Padcev received FDA accelerated approval in December 2019. Following Pfizer's acquisition of Seagen in 2023, Pfizer inherited Seagen's rights in this collaboration.
